ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels, with black pixels occupying approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface area against a field of high-contrast white mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-contrast white punctate blobs and mottling localized across the distal halves of both lobes; a solid low-intensity dark region radiates from the central peduncle attachment point toward the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a deep vertical displacement relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations characterized by irregular peaks and shallow valleys along the continuous trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the trailing edge of the lobes, transitioning to sharp, attenuated lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial distribution of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-3 pixels in diameter) across both ventral lobes, corresponding to extensive historic barnacle attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive pigmentation loss across the ventral surface manifesting as white punctate scarring; minor irregular jaggedness on the distal tip of the right lobe.
